blocks.text: LIVE: Alas Pilipinas vs China – Asian Games 2026 women’s volleyball MANILA, Philippines — Alas Pilipinas Women were swept by defending champion China, 18-25, 22-25, 8-25, in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Wednesday at Okazaki Chuo Sogo Park Gymnasium in Japan. Alas put up a gallant stand in the first two sets, but China, a nine-time Asian Games champion eyeing a three-peat, proved too much in their Pool B showdown, imposing its dominance in the third set with a 19-4 spread and never looked back.
